sources.notes: Main site loaded and lists event pages for 2026 (Diamond Jubilee, Neighbors Helping Neighbors, Paddles & Prosecco) with no dates on the home page. The actual opportunities calendar at volunteer.bergenvolunteers.org returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch. No dated item confirmed.

gaps: Restaurant wine dinners, chef's tables, whiskey and cigar nights: no restaurant in Bergen was found with a dated events page that loads. Wyckoff Tavern's events page was empty, Felina's /events redirects to a private-events page, Biddy O'Malley's /events was 404. These are announced on each restaurant's Instagram; needs a logged-in pass over the accounts of the ~115 places already in places-food-nightlife.json.

Wine shop tastings and classes: Total Wine River Edge blocked WebFetch (HTTP 403) on every URL tried; a 'Sips of the Season' class on Nov 12, 2026 showed in search results but its store could not be confirmed. No independent Bergen wine shop with a public tasting calendar was found. No Bergen distillery with events was found.
Drag brunch and jazz brunch: nothing current in Bergen. Only past one-offs (Drag Queen Bingo at Temple Emeth in Teaneck, March 2026; an undated drag brunch at The Craftsman in Fair Lawn).
Restaurant weeks: none found for Bergen towns for winter 2026-27 (Hoboken's runs Nov 9 to 22). The Ridgewood Guild calendar lists no restaurant week.
Alementary Brewing (Hackensack): website returned an empty page and Instagram @alementary's newest post is April 16, 2024, so it looks dormant or closed. Left out.
The Flavor Labs (Norwood and Paramus cooking classes): site loaded but its single-classes page showed no dates, so it was not listed.

Facebook Events location pages and Facebook groups: not readable without login. AllEvents.in is the only no-login proxy found. The Facebook pages listed (St. Leon, Filipino American Festival, Cars and Coffee NJ, DJ Edwin Martinez) loaded as a page title only.

Car shows and cruise nights: season is over. newjerseycarshows.com cruise-night page had no Bergen entries (monthly pages at /november-2026-car-shows.html were not checked). Leads seen only in snippets: Cars and Coffee New Jersey on Facebook ('LAST SHOW OF 2026' on Nov 1, location not confirmed as Bergen) and Audi Club NJ Cars and Coffee at Bagel Shack, 395 NJ-17, Mahwah (April 26, 2026 season opener). Re-scout in April.
Boxing and MMA: no current card found in Bergen. An older article mentions Abella Boxing Promotions' 'Bergen County Fight Night 2' in East Rutherford on a Friday July 29, which is not a 2026 date.

High school sports schedules: the Big North master calendar, Don Bosco's ArbiterLive page and Bergen Catholic's Sidearm site all need a real browser; no game rows were captured. highschoolsports.nj.com could not be fetched at all. St. Joseph Regional and NJSIAA winter tournament pages were not reached.
Minor league and semi-pro teams, esports venues: none found inside Bergen County.

Korean community: KCC Tenafly's site would not load from any tool; no events calendar was found for the Korean American Association of New Jersey, or for Fort Lee and Palisades Park Korean festivals (Palisades Park's Broad Avenue festival appears only in 2025 coverage). A Chinese American Community of Fort Lee Moon Festival (September 2026) showed up in one Instagram snippet with no organizer page.

Latino (Hackensack, Garfield, Fairview), Polish (Wallington, Garfield), Indian and Japanese community organizers: no organizer calendar found. Only one-offs via the festival guide (Garfield Multicultural Food and Music Festival in June, Diwali in Norwood in October, Japan Fes at Overpeck) and county ceremonies. The Pulaski Day banquet in Wallington appears on poland.us, which is news, not a calendar.

Filipino (Bergenfield): the borough held a Philippine Independence Day flag raising on June 14, 2026 and a Barrio Fest in 2022; no standing organizer calendar found beyond the two festival pages listed.

Adult rec leagues: NJ Play Sports names Bergen County in its title but lists no Bergen league or dates on the page read. No open-play adult league calendar found beyond the pickleball clubs and Meetup groups.

Run clubs: an 'In Motion Run Club' serving Englewood appears in Facebook snippets, but the Instagram handle tried (@inmotionrunclub, 12 followers) did not look like the right account. Fleet Feet race pages are linked from The Local Girl's 5K guide but were not loaded; racefaster.com did not resolve.

Ice rinks: no working schedule page found for Mackay Ice Rink (Englewood; only a parks registration page at parksrec.egov.basgov.com) or Fritz Dietl Ice Rink (the address tried shows a blank template site).

Not found at all: yoga-in-the-park or outdoor fitness series (out of season), fishing derbies, dog events, language-exchange meetups with in-person Bergen dates, young-professional groups with their own calendar (networking shows up only through The Local Girl's Networking category).
Flat Rock Brook Nature Center (Englewood): events page still shows an Aug 27, 2026 full moon hike and a September calendar PDF, so it was left out as stale.
